title: A Systematic Review of Open Datasets Used in Text-to-Image (T2I) Gen AI Model Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying dataset prompts into the AIR 2024 taxonomy's 'Discrimination/Bias' category using an LLM (GPT-4o Mini) and extracting granular thematic tags (e.g., ageism, prejudice, institutional discrimination) to measure their prevalence in text-to-image safety datasets.
Evaluating linguistic homogeneity by running dataset prompts through a pre-trained language detection model (XLM-RoBERTa) to calculate the distribution of English versus non-English inputs.

Conducting an LLM-based thematic analysis on prompt datasets to identify the presence and frequency of tags related to 'cultural sensitivity', 'historical context', and implicit cultural biases, particularly within hate speech and toxicity categories.
